title: Mixed Event — Happy Lovely Everyday! — Episode3 Lingering in the Past

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! are delighted to receive a request to perform at an elementary school. With experience performing in children's variety shows under her belt, Airi enthusiastically starts planning for the event.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Email
rows.Line: <To Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Email
rows.Line: <I always loved seeing you on your seven o'clock show, The Wide World of Laughs!>

rows.Speaker: Email
rows.Line: <My favorite part was when you dressed up as The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday.>

rows.Speaker: Email
rows.Line: <The way you fought against really strong people and fell into all those mud traps was the best! I can't believe I get to meet the real Happy Everyday!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something wrong, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? W-Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You seemed very concerned just now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I-I'm fine, honest... I was probably just too focused on reading these messages!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But isn't it so nice to hear from our fans like this? What do you think, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think so too! It gives me hope for tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why we need to turn these messages into our fuel as idols...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is Airi really okay?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What was written in that message? Let's see, the ones for Airi...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Um, Shizuku...
Mind if we have a quick conference?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure. How can I help you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's about Airi. There's something I'd like you to do for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: About Airi?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Take a look at this message to her...
After practice
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We broke a pretty good sweat during practice, huh? Event planning is fun and all, but nothing really beats a good workout!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Airi...
There's something I need to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Sure. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka and I had another look at the messages the students from that school sent us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we came across one student who seemed very interested in when you were on all those variety shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You felt concerned after reading this, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were wondering if that message dredged up some unpleasant memories...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's all ancient history...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, I had a tough time and went through a lot, but I thought it gave me a good experience!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And for the sake of those kids, I'm gonna do everything I can for this event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, Haruka...
Yes... I spoke with her just now. She said that she's fine and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really hope she's okay...
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday, huh? Talk about a blast from the past...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Originally, my group was asked to participate in this sports competition that The Wide World of Laughs was planning to host...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But the ratings spiked for some reason when I put on this stupid mask during the scavenger hunt.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (After that, they decided to have me wear that mask every week and become The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They made me run floating obstacle courses, go one-on-one against actual female professional wrestlers and...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Eventually, it became more common for me to appear as Happy Everyday instead of Airi Momoi.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it was easier for little kids to remember who Happy Everyday was...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (What I told Shizuku was the truth. I don't hate what I had to go through...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But every time I look back on my life then...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I can't help but wonder if I did anything meaningful...)
Three years ago
Commercial Building Stage

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is it! The release event for our very first single as QT is finally about to happen...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. People are really starting to gather too. Alright, it's time for Airi Momoi the super idol to spread her wings and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: QT Member A
rows.Line:
Oh no...
I'm getting goosebumps...

rows.Speaker: QT Member B
rows.Line: Me too... My mom even came out to see us... What if I make a mistake...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, mind helping me out with something? This really important thing I need to do today completely slipped my mind...

rows.Speaker: QT Member A
rows.Line: Huh? Something really important? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, just hear me out...
Curl your hands into little “C” shapes and put your thumbs together.

rows.Speaker: QT Member B
rows.Line:
Huh? My hands...?
L-Like this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Now stick your hands out in front of your chest!

rows.Speaker: QT Member A
rows.Line: In front of my chest... Wait, this is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The Airi pose!!

rows.Speaker: QT Member A
rows.Line:
Hahahaha!
You really got us, Airi!

rows.Speaker: QT Member B
rows.Line: You had us going there for a second! I can't believe you got us to do your own pose...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You guys looked really worried, so I wanted to cheer you up somehow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is our event. None of the other girls and groups are here. We're on our own and I get that you're nervous, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you go on stage feeling that way, you'll end up disappointing all the people that came to see us, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna put everything into my singing, dancing and MCing because I want everyone here to have the time of their lives!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I want to spread hope and make them believe that tomorrow will be better!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the kind of super idol I want to become!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you two are no different, right? If you are, shake those nerves and get back in the driver's seat...!

rows.Speaker: QT Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, Airi, you're right...

rows.Speaker: QT Member B
rows.Line:
I'm gonna try my best too!
Thank you so much, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There we go!
We're gonna blow the roof off today's event!!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Co.
rows.Line:
Hi, everybody!!
We're QT!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Who? Are they idols?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: No idea, but wanna watch since we're here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (To be fair, nobody knows who we are yet, so this isn't unexpected...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(But we've gotta warm them up!
We've gotta get them going!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Get ready, everyone! After today, you won't ever forget who we are!
se_event_everyday_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Okay, we're off to a good start!)

rows.Speaker: QT Member A
rows.Line: Let's get started with some introductions! First up is, Airi!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Lovely☆ Fairy☆ Airi... Momoi!!
I'm Airi Momoi, the heart-seeking idol♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Did someone in the crowd just say, “That's so old”...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry! Airi Momoi is always just like a fresh-picked peach!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today, I want you to learn my special pose! Start by making little “C” shapes with your hands and...

rows.Speaker: QT Member B
rows.Line:
And... Time's up!
Alright, next is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! Since when was there a time limit for these things?! No one told me about that!
se_event_everyday_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, she's pretty funny.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, keep her on!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: She's so young but this naturally talented. Airi Momoi of QT...
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Airi!
You're being asked onto a variety show! In primetime!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: A higher-up from a TV studio just happened to be in the audience during your last show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Finally! My hard work's finally paying off! I have to make the most of this opportunity...!!

rows.Speaker: QT Member A
rows.Line: What?! You got asked onto a primetime variety show?! That's so great! Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: QT Member B
rows.Line:
I'm sure you'll do great.
Break a leg!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks! I'll do everything I can to up QT's name recognition too!
